# Salesforce Releases / What's New — captured 2026-07-08

## Note
Direct fetch of salesforce.com/releases/, /agentforce/what-is-new/, and /news/* all return
HTTP 403 (consistent 06-16 through 07-08). Content sourced via WebSearch fallback.

## NEW this scan 2026-07-08 (Summer '26 dev release — previously MISSED, now captured)
- Headless 360 — the entire platform as API / MCP tool / CLI command to any authenticated
  caller. "Biggest theme of Summer '26." 60+ new MCP tools, 30+ preconfigured coding skills;
  Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers connect external MCP clients (Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor) to org
  data & business logic. [MAJOR new access surface for AI agents]
- Agent Skills — open format for extending agents; open-sourced sf-skills library, Claude Code compatible.
- Agent Fabric — governance layer for agents.
- AgentExchange — unified marketplace for agents/skills.
- Agentforce Vibes 2.0 — native in-Salesforce coding agent; full org awareness; multi-model
  (Claude Sonnet, GPT-5). (Revealed at TDX 2026.)
- New Agent button opens ONLY new Agentforce Builder starting week of July 13 2026 (legacy retired).

## Prior — Commerce & Service [REPORTED 2026-07-07]
- Agentforce Commerce GA (July 6): Shopper (B2C), Buyer (B2B, WhatsApp/SMS), Merchant (back-office)
  agents; ChatGPT catalog sync (GA), Google Search/AI Mode + Gemini app (coming summer 2026).
- Agentforce Help Agent GA July '26 — autonomous service agent, 6-click setup, pay-per-resolution.
- Agentforce Customer Service Portal GA July '26 — real-time adaptive self-service.

## Prior — Summer '26 "Agentic Enterprise" [REPORTED 2026-07-06]
- Multi-Agent Orchestration GA (Jun 15); Atlas Reasoning Engine 3.0; A2A open protocol;
  Agent Script + Agentforce Builder GA; "Create Agent" Flow element; IT Service Domain Pack
  (50+ agents); Agentforce Sales in Slack; Named Query API GA; Agent Builder API;
  Salesforce-hosted MCP servers GA; v67.0 security defaults.

## Prior — pre-scan (NOT new)
- Agentforce Operations — GA Apr 29 2026 (back-office: process coordination, data verification,
  compliance clearance, approval routing). Flow auto-sync/triggers Beta May 2026.
- Spring '26: Agentforce Voice, Field Service proactive ops.
